title: Result of report.ack: what was released
description: Request args: {"upto"}. Releases every kept report up to that cursor. Refused with location-withheld when the range holds a report the caller could not list, and with not-owner when it holds one made by another member's instruction; either releases nothing. Failed with unknown-cursor above the newest cursor. An older upto changes nothing, so a retry of a lost reply is harmless.
